notes: The minimum 100-trade floor is a project acceptance requirement, not a claim of statistical certainty.
Win rate must be strictly greater than 90%; exactly 90% does not pass.

Official paper performance is measured only from the append-only 1m precision-entry candidate/outcome ledger. A candidate counts only after a provenance-bound 15m setup passes its data, structure, confirmation, risk and geometry gates and the advisory 1m engine returns READY. The 15m preapproval and research-only cohorts are baseline diagnostics and never count toward acceptance.
Never force up to three signals; the daily limit is a cap, not a quota.

Do not mix 1m precision-entry paper outcomes, 15m preapproval baselines, official final-gate-approved outcomes, or research-only outcomes. Unresolved, ambiguous, malformed, or unlinked records never count toward the resolved sample.
No live order route is enabled by this contract.

signal_constraints.minimum_quality_claim: 15m setup and all data, structure, confirmation, risk and geometry gates PASS; 1m precision engine state READY
